messages:
anya: Heads-up 10m: MVP freeze in 6 business days. Two blockers surfaced: embeddings cache causing increased mem pressure in staging, and legal asking for extra review on multi-tenant SSO. My proposed cutlist: MUST: core REST gen, single-tenant SSO, telemetry & rollout hooks; SHOULD: dark-launch embeddings cache only if infra certifies a safe patch; CUT: tenant routing and advanced admin to v1.

rio: +1 to the proposal. Emb cache risky until infra confirms fix. If we dark-launch, require a 48h soak and automatic rollback on OOM or p95 spike.

sam: UX: cutting tenant routing breaks the demo flow for Prospects. I can ship a 1-screen demo shim (dropdown + fake tenant rows) in ~3d to keep demos intact. Low lift.

maria: Data note: without the cache, recommendation latency + CTR drop observed in perf runs (~15% latency, ~4% CTR). If we defer, add baseline perf tickets and a flag to measure lift when we enable.

kevin: Infra update: regression tied to KV eviction change. Hotfix ETA ~5d dev + 2d validation. If we insist on cache in MVP we'd need to slide internal readiness by ~7-8 business days.

anya: Decision rule: if infra confirms a validated hotfix and 48h soak before EOD Tue -> include cache behind dark-launch with strict canary and rollback. Otherwise -> cut cache to v1 + ship demo shim. Canary SLA: p95 token < 300ms and cost delta <1.5x, OOM or error-rate spike -> immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: milestone:Q2-MVP readiness updated by anya 1status: "cutlist-pending-infra"

anya: Action items: rio confirm hotfix ETA by EOD today; sam start demo-shim spike; maria create perf baseline tickets; kevin post final validation ETA. Reconvene tomorrow 10:00 for final call. :thumbsup:
